title: Project 3: Incident drills (game day)
summary: Practise incident response on the shipit stack: 12 break-and-fix drills across Docker, Kubernetes, Helm and Terraform, each with an injected fault, a symptom, hints, root cause and fix, and a blameless postmortem prompt.
objectives: Run an incident through detect, triage, mitigate, resolve and postmortem, mitigating before root-causing
Diagnose pod failures from status, events, exit codes and previous logs (CrashLoopBackOff, OOMKilled, exec format error, Pending)
Debug traffic problems along the request path: readiness, endpoints, NetworkPolicy, DNS and the Gateway
Recover from Helm upgrade failures and Terraform drift and stuck state locks safely
Write a blameless postmortem with contributing factors and owned action items
